metadata.title: Theory of Everything Research Programme: Block V Reflective Self-Modelling Confirmatory Dataset and Decision Record.
metadata.description:
This dataset release provides the original confirmatory evidence and preregistered decision record for Experimental Block V of the Theory of Everything Research Programme.

The study was preregistered at OSF under DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/JZ4ED before any held-out confirmatory seed was executed. Before confirmatory execution, a post-registration audit identified two execution-level ambiguities. A clarification update was publicly accepted by OSF before any confirmatory seed was run. The clarification fixed the exact H5.1 matched self-irrelevant control and utility as the primary H5.6 bypass metric without changing the frozen hypotheses, confirmatory seeds, held-out variants, architecture classes, misinformation/correction procedures, impairment ranges or other scientific criteria.

The release contains the twenty-seed confirmatory outputs, frozen-protocol snapshot, machine-readable analysis record, H5.1-H5.6 decision table, unlock and clarification provenance, and independent reproduction record.

The preregistered decisions were RETAIN for H5.1, H5.2, H5.3 and H5.5; RESTRICT for H5.4; and REDUCE for H5.6. Active self-monitoring provided selective benefit over passive monitoring; self-monitoring improved recovery after unannounced internal impairment; direct self-estimate misinformation produced the predicted behavioural deficit and restoring the accurate estimate rescued behaviour; and the endogenous self-monitor tracked internally generated capability change better than world-only uncertainty.

H5.4 was restricted because breaking episode-specific monitor correspondence produced the predicted directional effect but did not reach the frozen mean effect-size margins in both registered families. H5.6 was reduced because the strong H_EXTERNAL bypass remained within the preregistered margin of S2, showing that externally supplied calibrated self-relevant information was sufficient for the registered downstream control function.

Independent regeneration reproduced the per-seed confirmatory record, analysis record and decision table byte-for-byte.

This release is paired with the Block V software and reproducibility package (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23321474) and implements the experimental framework described in Working Paper III (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22857230).

The results do not establish phenomenal consciousness, subjective experience, sentience, human-like selfhood or conscious introspection.
